While this sub is a great place for people to come to for advice, I wonder if this is enough to keep the sub going. Do you guys and gals think we should stay strictly an advice sub or should we add the option to ask general dating and relationship questions? (i.e. "How did you meat your SO") If we do implement something like this, would you want post flairs? Post your thoughts :)
Should this sub be for advice only, or advice + general relationship advice?
I like the general questions options, might add a little light heartedness to this sub.

I think it should be anything relationship related. I feel like catering only to advice might also leaning toward people asking relationship advice when they have an issue. A more general approach might add some levity.

I vote for adding in general questions too. We're much more active than /v/dating. I'm kind of either way on flairs. It would be easier to tell when looking at the page of the sub which are general questions or sorting, but at the same time, I feel like people would be able to tell from the title.

True, but if the post count increases, especially in /new, it would be nice to be able to easily sort questions by a glance. At the same time, Voat doesn't allow for users to set flairs, it has to be set by mods (or a default one on new posts).

I don't see the effectiveness in a subverse that focuses primarily on "advice". If it were just advice, it should be something more specific, such as /v/relationshipadvice. Relationships are extremely complex entities that no person can ever really understand 100%. There should be a central location where Voaters can congregate and talk about the intricacies of a relationship.

Yes, more than advice should be present.
I like this place to encompass all things about relationships. We should all share wisdom, stories, grow, and learn together in the best way that we can.
